name: North Platte River — Glendo Powerplant to Wendover
gaugeName: North Platte River Below Glendo Reservoir, WY (USGS 06652800)
blurb: North Platte River: sections between Wyoming Game and Fish Department river access points.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Glendo Powerplant (North Platte): exact agency facility pin. Take-out Wendover (North Platte): exact agency facility pin. Wyoming: next to private land the streambed is private — no anchoring, wading or getting out without landowner permission; floating through is legal. Watercraft entering Wyoming Mar 1–Nov 30 need an AIS inspection. Mileage: preliminary NHDPlus V2 routed geometry (15.2 mi); no agency mileage found.
